annotations.title: Answer an ask waiting for my gym

description: Use this when an owner wants to accept or decline one ask held for the plan at their place, by its hold_id. Read the ask back to the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. Accept books the member in (a paid class is held while they pay on Phorme's own page; a full class puts them on the waitlist), or sends a 1:1 request on to the place's email. Decline ends it, with the owner's short note when they gave one. Either way the member hears. Accepting needs the gym plan at that place; the result then gives plan_url instead. It takes no payment. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to this answer.

note.description: For decline: a short note to the member, in the owner's words.

name: answer_held_request

hold.description: id, outcome (released, declined or expired) and booking_status.
